notes: §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR8 confines each group type to its page region (RH HEADING..FIRST DETAIL-1, or ..PAGE LIMIT on a page by itself; PH HEADING..FIRST DETAIL-1; CH/DE FIRST DETAIL..LAST DETAIL; CF FIRST DETAIL..FOOTING; PF FOOTING+1..LIMIT; RF FOOTING+1..LIMIT, or HEADING..LIMIT by itself), whether its lines are absolute or relative. GroupLimits computes the limits (no LAST CONTROL HEADING in a 1985 PAGE clause, so a CH's lower limit is LAST DETAIL), ScreenReportGroupLines refuses an absolute line outside them, a heading/footing whose relative lines (placed by MinimumLastLine) leave the region, and, in the arm gated on DialectLevel < 2002, an all-relative CH, DE or CF placed from FIRST DETAIL past its lower limit (COBOL2199). Probed at 85 (LIMIT 20, HEADING 2, FIRST DETAIL 6, LAST DETAIL 14, FOOTING 17), each boundary accepted and one past it refused: RH 2..5, line 1 and 6 refused, NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE 2..20 and PLUS to 20, 21 refused; PH 2..5, PLUS 1 + PLUS 4 (line 6) refused; CH 6..14, 15 refused; DE PLUS 1+8 ok, +9 refused, CH relative +9 refused; CF to 17, 18 and PLUS reaching 18 refused; PF 18..20, 17 refused; RF 18..20, 17 refused, 2 ON NEXT PAGE..20 ok, 1 ON NEXT PAGE and a relative tail to 21 refused. Edition arm: the too-tall relative detail is accepted at 2002 and 2023 (run-time EC-REPORT-PAGE-LIMIT). Leads for the PAGE and LINE format rows: FIRST DE, LAST CH, HEADING IS, n COLUMNS and a bare LINE NEXT PAGE (2002 forms) are accepted at 85. Witness: a page heading at absolute line 6 with FIRST DETAIL 5 is refused.

next.reason: 1985 SR8, a syntax rule, requires every report group, of absolute or relative lines, to 'be defined such that it can be presented in the vertical subdivision of the page' of its type. 2023 keeps the regions (§2023:13.18.39.4 GR1 'each report group shall be confined within one or more of these regions', GR3, GR4; §2023:13.18.57.4 GR7, GR8), but its compile-time check covers only absolute lines (§2023:13.18.35.3 SR6 c) 'Any absolute report lines shall be defined in such a way that no line appears above the upper limit or below the lower limit', and d)); for a group that cannot be printed on one page §2023:13.18.35.4 GR2 says 'If this rule is violated the EC-REPORT-PAGE-LIMIT exception condition is set to exist and the results are undefined.' An all-relative group too tall for its region, refused by 1985, is no longer a syntax-rule refusal.
